caseTitle.en: The other half of the medicine bag

condition.zh: 中西藥交互作用 · 抗凝

tagline.zh: 一袋西藥、一罐丹參粉、一杯當開水喝的甘草茶
tagline.en: A bag of tablets, a jar of danshen powder, and liquorice tea drunk like water

desc.zh: 在中西醫整合門診跟診。你開的每一帖藥，都會和病人藥袋裡的另一半相遇。
desc.en: Rotating through the integrated clinic. Every formula you write will meet the other half of the patient's medicine bag.

desc.zh: 中西藥都要懂。你的工作是把病人帶來的每一樣東西攤開、查清楚、打電話。
desc.en: Fluent in both pharmacies. Your job is to lay out everything the patient brought, look it all up, and pick up the phone.

role.zh: 中西醫整合內科主治（師傅）

about.zh: 病人進門，他第一句話不是「哪裡不舒服」，而是「藥袋帶了嗎？」
about.en: When a patient walks in, his first words are not “what's wrong?” but “did you bring your medicine bag?”

about.zh: 三支螢光筆：黃色畫西藥、綠色畫中藥、粉紅色畫「兩個加起來會出事」。粉紅色永遠最先用完。
about.en: Three highlighters: yellow for tablets, green for herbs, pink for “these two together mean trouble”. The pink one always runs out first.

about.zh: 抓藥前一定問一句「你還有在吃什麼？」，被病人嫌囉唆了二十年，從來不改。
about.en: Asks “what else are you taking?” before every pack. Patients have called her a nag for twenty years; she has never stopped.

role.zh: 七十六歲，心房顫動吃抗凝藥

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休裁縫，手很巧，眼睛還很利。鄰居說丹參「通血路」，她就天天沖一匙。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired seamstress, nimble hands, sharp eyes. A neighbour said danshen “clears the blood roads”, so she stirs a spoonful into water every day.

about.zh: 每週陪阿嬤看三個門診，手機裡有一本用藥備忘錄，但只記了西藥。
about.en: Takes Grandma to three clinics a week. Keeps a medicine memo on her phone, but only for the tablets.

role.zh: 五十八歲，高血壓、夜間小腿抽筋

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。計程車司機。自己泡甘草茶當開水喝：「甘草調和百藥，喝了不會錯。」
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Taxi driver. Brews liquorice tea and drinks it like water: “Liquorice harmonises everything; it can't do any harm.”

about.zh: 講話很快，但每個重點會講兩次。很歡迎中醫部打電話來。
about.en: Talks fast but says every key point twice. Always glad when the TCM department calls.

plain.zh: 兩樣東西一起吃，效果變強、變弱或多出副作用。中藥和西藥之間也會有。
plain.en: Two things taken together become stronger, weaker or cause new side effects. It happens between herbs and Western drugs too.

plain.zh: 讓血比較不容易凝固的藥，用來預防血塊。心房顫動的人吃它，是為了不讓心臟裡的血塊跑到腦部造成中風。
plain.en: A drug that makes blood slower to clot, to prevent clots. In atrial fibrillation it stops clots forming in the heart and travelling to the brain as a stroke.

plain.zh: 老牌的口服抗凝血劑。效果很容易被食物、其他藥物和中藥改變，所以要定期抽血監測。
plain.en: A long-established oral anticoagulant. Its effect is easily shifted by food, other drugs and herbs, so it needs regular blood tests.

plain.zh: 抽血看血液凝固要花多久的指標。數字越高越容易流血；吃華法林的人靠它調藥。
plain.en: A blood test of how long blood takes to clot. The higher it is, the easier the bleeding; people on warfarin are dosed by it.

plain.zh: 心房亂跳，脈搏快慢不一、強弱不等。血在心房裡淤積容易成塊，所以要抗凝。
plain.en: The upper heart chambers quiver chaotically; the pulse is irregular in rate and strength. Blood pools and clots, hence anticoagulation.

plain.zh: 中醫認為讓血行通暢、化掉瘀滯的治法。丹參、當歸、川芎、紅花、桃仁都在這一類，現代研究發現不少會影響凝血。
plain.en: In TCM reasoning, the method that moves blood and dissolves stasis. Danshen, dang gui, chuanxiong, safflower and peach kernel all belong here, and many are now known to affect clotting.

plain.zh: 中醫認為推動血行的氣不夠，血就走得慢、容易瘀。年長的心臟病人常見。
plain.en: In TCM reasoning, too little qi to push the blood, so it slows and stagnates. Common in older people with heart disease.

plain.zh: 脈來不流利，像刀輕刮竹子，往來艱澀、節律參差。中醫認為主血瘀或精血虧；心房顫動的人常摸到類似的脈。
plain.en: A pulse that will not flow, like a knife scraping bamboo, uneven in its coming and going. TCM reads blood stasis or depleted blood; people with AF often feel like this.

plain.zh: 舌色淡而帶紫。淡主氣虛，紫主血瘀，合起來就是氣虛血瘀的舌。
plain.en: A tongue that is pale with a purple cast. Pale points to qi deficiency, purple to stasis; together, qi deficiency with blood stasis.

plain.zh: 把病人所有在吃的東西：處方藥、中藥、保健品、偏方，一次列清楚，找重複、找衝突、找漏掉的。
plain.en: Listing everything a patient takes: prescriptions, herbs, supplements, home remedies, all at once, to find duplicates, clashes and gaps.

plain.zh: 請病人把家裡所有的藥和保健品裝成一袋帶來，藥師一樣一樣看。比問「還有吃別的嗎」準確得多。
plain.en: Asking patients to bring every medicine and supplement from home in one bag, then going through it item by item. Far more accurate than asking “anything else?”

plain.zh: 大量、長期吃甘草，身體會像荷爾蒙過多一樣留鈉排鉀：血壓升高、水腫、血鉀變低。
plain.en: Large amounts of liquorice over time make the body hold salt and lose potassium as if flooded with a hormone: higher blood pressure, swelling, low potassium.

plain.zh: 血中鉀離子太低：肌肉無力、抽筋、心律不整。利尿劑和大量甘草都會讓鉀流失。
plain.en: Too little potassium in the blood: weak muscles, cramps, an irregular heartbeat. Diuretics and large amounts of liquorice both wash it out.

plain.zh: 中醫說甘草、白芍能讓攣急的筋放鬆。小腿抽筋常用芍藥配甘草，就是這個道理。
plain.en: TCM says liquorice and white peony relax a cramped sinew. That is why peony paired with liquorice is a classic for calf cramps.

plain.zh: 容易瘀青、刷牙流血、流鼻血止不住。有出血傾向的人，刮痧、拔罐、刺絡放血都不做。
plain.en: Easy bruising, bleeding gums, nosebleeds that will not stop. With a bleeding tendency, no scraping, no cupping, no bloodletting.

text.zh: 脈枕旁邊貼著一張小卡：「先問藥袋，再摸脈。」是鄭老師的字。
text.en: A small card is taped beside the pulse pillow: “Ask for the bag, then take the pulse.” Teacher Cheng's handwriting.

text.zh: 左欄西藥、右欄中藥，中間畫粉紅線。最粗的一條：抗凝血劑對活血藥。第二粗：利尿劑對甘草。
text.en: Tablets on the left, herbs on the right, pink lines between. The thickest: anticoagulants to blood-quickening herbs. The next: diuretics to liquorice.

text.zh: 丹參、當歸、紅花、桃仁並排，每一格貼著一張黃卡：「與抗凝血劑併用注意」。
text.en: Danshen, dang gui, safflower and peach kernel side by side, each with a yellow card: “Caution with anticoagulants”.

text.zh: 一個印著布莊名字的舊提袋。華法林、降壓藥、胃藥、一罐丹參粉、一包當歸、一盒紅花茶，還有別家診所的血府逐瘀湯顆粒。
text.en: An old tote printed with a fabric shop's name. Warfarin, a blood-pressure pill, a stomach pill, a jar of danshen powder, a bag of dang gui, a box of safflower tea, and Xuefu Zhuyu Tang granules from another clinic.

text.zh: 今天又用完一支。她把新的那支塞給你：「下次你畫。」
text.en: Another one used up today. She presses a fresh one on you: “Next time you do the drawing.”

text.zh: 丹參、當歸等可能增強華法林作用，INR 上升；紅花、桃仁、川芎有活血之性，疊在抗凝藥上，出血風險加總。人參類則有報告讓華法林效果變弱。方向不一，所以規則是：吃抗凝藥的人，加任何中藥前先告知心臟科、監測 INR；已經出血就先停中藥，抗凝藥由心臟科決定，不由病人或中醫自行停。
text.en: Danshen and dang gui may strengthen warfarin and raise the INR; safflower, peach kernel and chuanxiong add their own blood-moving action on top, so bleeding risk adds up. Ginsengs have been reported to weaken warfarin instead. The direction varies, so the rule is: before adding any herb for someone on an anticoagulant, tell cardiology and monitor the INR; if they are already bleeding, stop the herbs first, and leave the anticoagulant decision to cardiology, never to the patient or the TCM doctor alone.

text.zh: 方裡的甘草是「國老」，份量小、調和諸藥。但天天當茶喝、長期大量，甘草酸會讓身體留鈉排鉀：血壓升、腳踝腫、血鉀低。再加上排鉀的利尿劑，低血鉀更快來，抽筋、無力，嚴重時心律不整。處方裡的甘草和茶壺裡的甘草，要分開算、一起記。
text.en: In a formula liquorice is the “state elder”: a small amount that harmonises the rest. Drunk daily as tea in large amounts for months, its glycyrrhizin makes the body keep salt and lose potassium: rising pressure, puffy ankles, low potassium. Add a potassium-wasting diuretic and the low potassium comes faster: cramps, weakness, and at worst an irregular heart. Liquorice in a prescription and liquorice in a teapot are counted separately and recorded together.

text.zh: 一、全部列出：處方藥、中藥、保健品、偏方，連「鄰居給的」也算。二、逐項對適應症與證型。三、查交互作用與重複成分。四、有疑慮打給開立的醫師，由醫師決定改藥。五、用病人聽得懂的話衛教，請他回述，並約好追蹤。
text.en: One: list everything, prescriptions, herbs, supplements, remedies, including “what the neighbour gave me”. Two: match each to an indication and a pattern. Three: check interactions and duplicated ingredients. Four: when in doubt, phone the prescriber, who decides any change. Five: counsel in plain words, have the patient say it back, and book a follow-up.

text.zh: 吃抗凝藥的人出現：黑便或血便、吐血或咖啡色嘔吐物、劇烈頭痛或嘔吐、單側無力或說話不清、血尿、流鼻血壓迫仍止不住，立即送急診。輕微瘀青、牙齦滲血：當天驗 INR、通知開藥醫師。這段時間刮痧、拔罐、刺絡放血一律不做，針刺也要先評估。
text.en: In anyone on an anticoagulant: black or bloody stools, vomiting blood or coffee-grounds, severe headache or vomiting, one-sided weakness or slurred speech, blood in the urine, a nosebleed that pressure will not stop: emergency department now. Minor bruising or oozing gums: INR the same day and tell the prescriber. Meanwhile no scraping, no cupping, no bloodletting, and needling only after assessment.

note.zh: 用藥整合五步；白板上的粉紅線
note.en: Five reconciliation steps; the pink lines on the board

guide.en: Find Teacher Cheng in the clinic

lines.zh: 早上八點。脈枕旁貼著小卡：「先問藥袋，再摸脈。」余藥師在白板上畫第三條粉紅線。
lines.en: Eight in the morning. The card by the pulse pillow says: “Ask for the bag, then take the pulse.” Pharmacist Yu is drawing a third pink line on the whiteboard.

lines.zh: 這個門診專看一件事：中藥和西藥一起吃，會不會打架。你先說，什麼叫交互作用？
lines.en: This clinic looks at one thing: whether herbs and tablets fight. You first: what is an interaction?

lines.zh: 兩樣東西一起吃，效果變強、變弱，或多出副作用。
lines.en: Two things taken together become stronger, weaker, or make new side effects.

lines.zh: 好。那病人自己知道他在吃幾樣東西嗎？
lines.en: Good. And does the patient know how many things he takes?

lines.zh: 通常不知道。所以我們請他把整袋帶來，叫藥袋評估。問的永遠比看的少。
lines.en: Usually not. So we ask for the whole bag: a brown-bag review. What people tell you is always less than what they carry.

guide.zh: 在白板前排出整合步驟
guide.en: Order the steps at the whiteboard

lines.zh: 用藥整合有固定順序。你今天每個病人都會走一次，先排一遍給我看。
lines.en: Medication reconciliation has a fixed order. You'll walk every patient through it today. Lay it out once for me.

q.zh: 中西藥用藥整合的正確順序
q.en: The correct order of herb–drug medication reconciliation

steps.zh: 列出全部：西藥中藥保健品偏方
逐項核對適應症與證型
steps.en: Match each to indication and pattern

steps.zh: 查交互作用與重複成分

steps.en: Phone the prescriber if in doubt

post.zh: 第四步最常被省略。藥師和中醫都沒有權限替心臟科停藥，但都有義務打電話。
post.en: Step four is the one people skip. Neither the pharmacist nor the TCM doctor may stop a cardiology drug, but both are obliged to phone.

post.zh: 白板最粗那條粉紅線，今天應該會用到。
post.en: The thickest pink line on the board; I suspect we'll use it today.

note.zh: 舌淡紫、澀脈：氣虛血瘀，也是心房顫動
note.en: Pale purple tongue, choppy pulse: stasis, and also AF

guide.en: Seat Grandma Yeh at the desk

lines.zh: 醫生，我胸口悶悶的，腳也沒力。鄰居說我是血路不通，叫我吃丹參。
lines.en: Doctor, my chest feels tight and my legs are weak. The neighbour says my blood roads are blocked and told me to take danshen.

lines.zh: 她手臂這幾天一直青一塊紫一塊，她說是撞到桌角。早上刷牙也有流血。
lines.en: Her arms have been black and blue these few days; she says she bumped the table. Her gums bled this morning too.

lines.zh: 裁縫做一輩子，桌角我最熟，哪會撞？……好啦，可能沒撞。
lines.en: Fifty years a seamstress; I know every table corner. Bump into one? …All right, maybe I didn't.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，舌頭伸出來給我們看一下。燈打亮一點。
lines.en: Grandma, stick out your tongue for us. Turn the lamp up a little.

q.zh: 葉阿嬤的舌：淡而帶紫，苔薄白。胸悶、乏力、易瘀青。中醫證型？
q.en: Grandma Yeh's tongue: pale with a purple cast, thin white coat. Chest tightness, fatigue, easy bruising. The TCM pattern?

why.zh: 舌淡紫：淡主氣虛，紫主血瘀。胸悶乏力是氣不足推不動血。中醫思路上確實會想到活血，所以鄰居的話不是沒道理，問題在她同時吃什麼。
why.en: Pale purple: pale means weak qi, purple means stasis. Tight chest and fatigue are qi too weak to push the blood. TCM reasoning would indeed reach for blood-quickening herbs, so the neighbour was not entirely wrong; the problem is what else she takes.

why.zh: 熱入營血舌絳紅、身熱夜甚、斑疹。她的舌是淡的，沒有發燒。
why.en: Heat in the blood gives a crimson tongue, fever worse at night, rashes. Her tongue is pale and she has no fever.

why.zh: 脾虛濕盛舌胖齒痕、苔膩。她的舌形正常，紫色是重點。
why.en: Spleen deficiency with damp gives a swollen, tooth-marked tongue and a greasy coat. Her tongue shape is normal; the purple is the clue.

why.zh: 肝陽上亢舌紅、頭脹痛、面紅易怒、脈弦。和淡紫舌、乏力不合。
why.en: Ascendant liver yang gives a red tongue, a pounding head, a flushed face, irritability and a wiry pulse. Not a pale purple tongue and fatigue.

post.zh: 舌淡紫，氣虛血瘀。中醫會想活血化瘀，這就是陷阱開始的地方。
post.en: Pale purple: qi deficiency with blood stasis. TCM would want to quicken the blood, and that is exactly where the trap begins.

lines.zh: 寸關尺，先輕後重。不要只數快慢，感覺它來去順不順。
lines.en: Cun, guan, chi, light then deep. Don't only count the speed; feel whether it flows.

lines.zh: 來得不順，像卡卡的。快慢不一，強弱也不一。
lines.en: It does not flow; it catches. Uneven in speed, uneven in strength.

q.zh: 葉阿嬤的脈：往來不流利，快慢強弱參差。這是什麼脈？
q.en: Grandma Yeh's pulse: it will not flow; speed and strength are uneven. Name it.

why.zh: 往來艱澀、參差不調，是澀脈，中醫認為主血瘀。用現代的話說，快慢強弱都不一，正是心房顫動的手感，也是她吃抗凝血劑的原因。
why.en: Halting and uneven: the choppy pulse, which TCM reads as blood stasis. In modern words, irregular rate and strength is exactly how atrial fibrillation feels under the fingers, and why she is on an anticoagulant.

why.zh: 滑脈如珠走盤，往來流利。她的正好相反。
why.en: A slippery pulse rolls like pearls on a plate, flowing easily. Hers is the opposite.

why.zh: 洪脈來盛去衰，又大又有力，多見實熱。阿嬤的脈不大、無力。
why.en: A surging pulse arrives big and strong, a sign of excess heat. Hers is neither big nor strong.

why.zh: 緊脈像繃緊的繩子左右彈，主寒主痛，節律整齊。
why.en: A tight pulse twangs like a taut rope, pointing to cold or pain, with a regular rhythm.

post.zh: 澀脈。中醫說血瘀，心臟科說心房顫動。兩個名字，同一隻手。
post.en: Choppy. TCM says stasis, cardiology says atrial fibrillation. Two names, one wrist.

post.zh: 所以她本來就在吃華法林……再加活血藥。
post.en: So she is already on warfarin… and then blood-quickening herbs on top.

note.zh: 四樣活血藥疊在抗凝藥上；誰能停藥
note.en: Four blood-movers on an anticoagulant; who stops what

guide.zh: 和余藥師一起攤開藥袋
guide.en: Empty the bag with Pharmacist Yu

lines.zh: 布莊的舊提袋倒在桌上。藥盒、藥包、玻璃罐，排了半張桌子。
lines.en: The old fabric-shop tote is tipped onto the desk. Boxes, packets, a glass jar; half the desk is covered.

lines.zh: 黃色先畫：華法林、降壓藥、胃藥。綠色是你的。哪幾樣要換成粉紅色？
lines.en: Yellow first: warfarin, the blood-pressure pill, the stomach pill. Green is yours. Which of these turn pink?

lines.zh: 我手機只記了醫院的藥。這些罐子……我以為是食物。
lines.en: My phone list only has the hospital tablets. These jars… I thought they were food.

q.zh: 葉阿嬤袋子裡，哪些藥材和抗凝血劑併用會增加出血風險？
q.en: Which herbs in Grandma Yeh's bag raise bleeding risk alongside an anticoagulant?

post.zh: 丹參粉、當歸燉雞、紅花茶，還有別家開的血府逐瘀湯，裡面又有桃仁、紅花、川芎、當歸。
post.en: Danshen powder, dang gui in chicken soup, safflower tea, plus Xuefu Zhuyu Tang from another clinic, which itself holds peach kernel, safflower, chuanxiong and dang gui.

post.zh: 同一個方向疊了四層。抗凝血劑一層、活血藥三層。瘀青不是撞的。
post.en: Four layers pushing the same way: one anticoagulant, three layers of blood-movers. The bruises were not from a table.
I told you I didn't bump anything.

lines.zh: 瘀青、牙齦流血，還沒有黑便、頭痛。你是今天的住院醫師，怎麼處理？
lines.en: Bruising and bleeding gums; no black stools or headache yet. You're today's resident. What do you do?

q.zh: 葉阿嬤吃華法林，同時吃四種活血中藥，出現瘀青、牙齦出血。你怎麼做？
q.en: Grandma Yeh is on warfarin plus four blood-quickening herbs, with bruising and bleeding gums. What do you do?

options.zh: 抗凝藥照吃、活血藥先停，今天驗INR
options.en: Keep warfarin, stop the herbs, INR today

why.zh: 先拿掉疊上去的那幾層，抗凝藥本身由心臟科決定。當天驗 INR、打給心臟科，是唯一能讓兩邊都看清楚的路。
why.en: Remove the layers stacked on top; the anticoagulant itself is cardiology's call. INR today and a phone call to cardiology is the only way both sides see clearly.

options.zh: 中藥也活血，華法林先停掉
options.en: Herbs move blood too; stop warfarin

why.zh: 活血藥不是抗凝血劑，擋不了心房裡的血塊。自行停華法林，中風風險會立刻上來。停不停，由心臟科決定。
why.en: Blood-quickening herbs are not anticoagulants and cannot stop clots in the atrium. Stopping warfarin on our own raises the stroke risk at once. That decision belongs to cardiology.

options.zh: 兩邊各減一半，都吃一點
options.en: Halve both and keep a little of each

why.zh: 減半聽起來折衷，其實兩邊都失控：INR 不知道往哪走，華法林的劑量也不是我們能改的。
why.en: Halving sounds like compromise but leaves both out of control: nobody knows where the INR goes, and warfarin dosing is not ours to change.

lines.zh: 阿嬤肩膀很酸，我們家附近有刮痧，可以帶她去刮一刮嗎？
lines.en: Grandma's shoulders ache. There's a guasha place near us; can I take her for a scrape?

q.zh: 吃抗凝血劑、正在瘀青的阿嬤，家屬想帶她去刮痧拔罐。
q.en: Grandma, on an anticoagulant and bruising, and the family wants scraping and cupping.

options.zh: 有出血傾向，刮痧拔罐都不做
options.en: Bleeding tendency: no scraping or cupping

why.zh: 刮痧、拔罐本來就是讓皮下微血管出痧。在抗凝的人身上，會變成大片皮下出血。刺絡放血更不行。
why.en: Scraping and cupping work by bringing up petechiae. On an anticoagulant they become large bruises under the skin. Bloodletting is even more out of the question.

why.zh: 出痧就是微血管破，沒有「輕到不出血」的刮痧。
why.en: The marks are broken capillaries. There is no scraping so gentle that nothing bleeds.

why.zh: 拔罐的負壓一樣會造成皮下出血，兩個都暫停。
why.en: Cupping's suction causes bruising too. Both are off for now.

post.zh: 肩膀酸，可以熱敷、輕柔活動。等 INR 穩了，再來談針灸要怎麼做。
post.en: For the sore shoulders: warmth and gentle movement. Once the INR is steady, we can talk about how to needle her.

note.zh: 流鼻血：坐直前傾、捏鼻翼；INR 偏高
note.en: Nosebleed: sit up, lean forward, pinch; INR high

guide.en: Grandma's nose is bleeding on the couch

lines.zh: 抽完血，阿嬤在隔簾後休息。美玲探頭出來：「她流鼻血了，一直滴！」
lines.en: After the blood test Grandma rests behind the curtain. Mei-ling leans out: “Her nose is bleeding, it won't stop dripping!”

lines.zh: 沒事啦，我躺下來、頭往後仰就好。
lines.en: It's nothing. I'll lie down and tip my head back.

options.zh: 坐直前傾、捏住鼻翼持續壓迫
options.en: Sit up, lean forward, pinch the soft nose

why.zh: 前傾讓血往外流，不會吞下去或嗆到；捏住鼻翼軟骨持續壓迫，冰敷鼻樑。壓迫一段時間仍止不住、量多或頭暈，就送急診。
why.en: Leaning forward lets blood drain out instead of being swallowed or inhaled; firm continuous pressure on the soft part of the nose, ice on the bridge. Still bleeding after a good while, heavy, or dizzy: emergency department.

why.zh: 頭後仰，血會流進喉嚨，吞下去會噁心嘔吐，也看不出流了多少。
why.en: Head back sends blood down the throat; swallowed blood causes vomiting and hides how much is lost.

options.zh: 塞一團衛生紙就去候診
options.en: Stuff in tissue and go back to wait

why.zh: 抗凝的人鼻血不會自己乖乖停。沒有持續壓迫，等於沒處理。
why.en: On an anticoagulant a nosebleed will not politely stop. Without steady pressure, nothing has been done.

post.zh: 前傾、捏住、冰敷。過了一陣子，血停了。阿嬤手裡還捏著那團針線，說要幫你縫掉了的扣子。
post.en: Lean forward, pinch, ice. After a while it stops. Grandma is still clutching her needle and thread, offering to sew on your missing button.

lines.zh: INR 看到了，偏高，高出目標不少。偏高，我說兩次。今天華法林先暫停一次，明天回來再驗。
lines.en: Saw the INR. High, well above target. High; I'm saying it twice. Hold today's warfarin, recheck tomorrow.

lines.zh: 收到。活血中藥我們已經全部停了，也會跟家屬說黑便、頭痛就直接急診。
lines.en: Noted. We've stopped all the blood-quickening herbs, and I'll tell the family black stools or headache mean straight to emergency.

lines.zh: 謝謝你打來。下次她要吃任何中藥，請先通知我們，一起看 INR。
lines.en: Thanks for calling. Next time she starts any herb, let us know first and we'll watch the INR together.

guide.en: Teacher Cheng hands you the phone

lines.zh: INR 報告出來了，偏高。剛剛的建議，心臟科知道嗎？
lines.en: The INR is back, high. Does cardiology know what you advised?

lines.zh: ……還不知道。我現在打。
lines.en: …Not yet. I'll call now.

lines.zh: 林醫師在電話裡說：「華法林今天暫停一次、明天再驗，劑量我來調。活血中藥全停。下次先打給我。」
lines.en: Dr Lin on the line: “Hold today's warfarin, recheck tomorrow, I'll adjust the dose. All blood-quickening herbs stop. Next time call me first.”

lines.zh: 抗凝藥的開關不在我們手上，但電話在。
lines.en: The anticoagulant's switch is not in our hands. The phone is.

note.zh: 甘草加利尿劑：低血鉀；承山緩抽筋
note.en: Liquorice plus diuretic: low potassium; BL57 for cramps

lines.zh: 半夜小腿抽筋，痛到醒。白天開車腳軟，踩煞車都怕。
lines.en: Calf cramps wake me at night. In the day my legs go weak; I'm nervous on the brake.

lines.zh: 我有吃芍藥甘草的顆粒，人家說治抽筋。甘草茶我當水喝，甘草調和百藥嘛。
lines.en: I take peony-and-liquorice granules; they're meant for cramps. And I drink liquorice tea like water. Liquorice harmonises everything, right?

lines.zh: 降血壓的藥是哪一種？……利尿劑。最近量血壓呢？
lines.en: Which blood-pressure pill? …A diuretic. And your readings lately?

lines.zh: 比以前高，腳踝也有點腫。醫生還說要加藥。
lines.en: Higher than before, and my ankles are a bit puffy. The doctor wants to add a pill.

q.zh: 利尿劑、天天大量甘草茶、抽筋無力、血壓上升、腳踝腫。最可能是？
q.en: A diuretic, large daily liquorice tea, cramps and weakness, rising pressure, swollen ankles. Most likely?

why.zh: 大量甘草造成偽醛固酮增多症：留鈉、排鉀、血壓升、水腫；利尿劑再排一次鉀。抽筋無力正是低血鉀。要抽血驗電解質。
why.en: Large amounts of liquorice cause pseudoaldosteronism: salt kept, potassium lost, pressure up, swelling; the diuretic flushes potassium again. Cramps and weakness are low potassium. He needs electrolytes checked.

options.zh: 缺鈣，甘草茶再喝多一點
options.en: Low calcium; drink more liquorice tea

why.zh: 甘草茶就是問題的一半。再多喝，鉀掉得更兇。
why.en: The tea is half the problem. More of it and the potassium falls faster.

options.zh: 血壓控制差，利尿劑加量

why.zh: 血壓高的原因在茶壺裡。加利尿劑只會讓鉀更低。
why.en: The cause of the pressure is in the teapot. More diuretic only drops the potassium further.

post.zh: 芍藥甘草能緩急止痛，中醫的推理沒錯。錯在份量：方裡的甘草是調和，茶壺裡的是一整天。
post.en: Peony with liquorice does ease spasm and pain; the TCM reasoning holds. The error is quantity: liquorice in a formula harmonises; liquorice in a teapot is all day long.
So… even liquorice can go wrong?

post.zh: 調和百藥的，自己也是藥。
post.en: The herb that harmonises all the others is still a herb itself.

guide.en: Show Mr Tseng the point Chengshan

lines.zh: 那半夜抽起來的時候，我可以自己做什麼？
lines.en: So when it grabs me in the night, what can I do myself?

lines.zh: 腳背往上勾、伸直小腿。再教他一個穴，在圖上點給他看。
lines.en: Pull the toes up and straighten the calf. And teach him one point; show him on the chart.

q.zh: 點出小腿抽筋時常按的承山
q.en: Locate Chengshan (BL57), pressed for calf cramps

post.zh: 承山在小腿後面，腳尖踮起來時，肌肉分成人字形的尖端下方凹陷。慢慢按到痠脹就好。
post.en: Chengshan is on the back of the calf, in the hollow below the point of the inverted V the muscle makes when you rise on tiptoe. Press slowly until it aches a little.

post.zh: 按穴解決今晚，抽血解決原因。今天下午就驗鉀，結果出來我們和家醫科一起看。
post.en: Pressing solves tonight; the blood test solves the cause. Potassium this afternoon, and we read it with his family doctor.

guide.en: Write the note to his GP

lines.zh: 照會單寫三行：大量甘草茶、芍藥甘草顆粒、利尿劑。疑似低血鉀，已抽電解質。請評估降壓藥。
lines.en: Three lines on the note: large daily liquorice tea, peony-liquorice granules, a diuretic. Suspected low potassium; electrolytes drawn. Please review the antihypertensive.

lines.zh: 要不要寫「建議改藥」？
lines.en: Should I write “recommend changing the drug”?

lines.zh: 寫事實和疑慮，不替別人開處方。家醫科看到這三行，自己會知道。
lines.en: Write the facts and the concern; don't prescribe for someone else. Three lines like that and the GP will know.

lines.zh: 傍晚報告回來：血鉀偏低。家醫科回覆：停甘草茶，調整降壓藥，一週後追蹤。
lines.en: The result comes back late afternoon: potassium low. The GP replies: stop the liquorice tea, adjust the antihypertensive, follow up in a week.

note.zh: 最好的方有時是不開；砂仁打碎後下
note.en: Sometimes the best formula is none; crush the amomum

guide.zh: 問鄭老師阿嬤要開什麼方
guide.en: Ask what Grandma should be prescribed

lines.zh: 阿嬤還是氣虛血瘀，胸悶乏力。我們要開什麼方給她？
lines.en: Grandma is still qi deficient with stasis, tight-chested and tired. What do we prescribe?

lines.zh: 今天什麼都不開。INR 還沒穩，加任何一味，心臟科都看不清楚是誰造成的。
lines.en: Nothing today. Her INR isn't steady; add any herb and cardiology can't tell what caused what.

lines.zh: 等 INR 穩了，和林醫師一起決定。到時候先選不走活血那條路的方，慢慢加、慢慢看。
lines.en: Once it settles we decide with Dr Lin. Then we choose a formula that doesn't go down the blood-quickening road, add slowly, watch slowly.

lines.zh: 最好的方，有時是不開。
lines.en: Sometimes the best formula is none.

lines.zh: 這句話寫在你的筆記本第一頁。
lines.en: Write that on the first page of your notebook.

lines.zh: 曾先生的新方：鄭老師看他腳腫、胃口差、舌胖，開香砂六君子湯，不再加芍藥甘草顆粒。
lines.en: Mr Tseng's new formula: Teacher Cheng saw the swollen ankles, poor appetite and puffy tongue, and wrote Xiangsha Liujunzi Tang, with no more peony-liquorice granules.

lines.zh: 方裡的炙甘草份量是調和用的，跟茶壺不能比。但我還是寫進用藥紀錄。你還有在吃什麼？我問你的。
lines.en: The honey-fried liquorice in it is a harmonising amount, nothing like a teapot. I still write it in his record. And what else are you taking? I'm asking you.

lines.zh: 我？……咖啡。
lines.en: Me? …Coffee.

lines.zh: 好，記下來了。四君子湯加四味變香砂六君，加哪四味？挑給我。
lines.en: Noted. Sijunzi Tang plus four herbs makes Xiangsha Liujunzi. Which four? Pick them.

q.zh: 香砂六君子湯在四君子湯上加了哪四味？
q.en: Which four herbs turn Sijunzi Tang into Xiangsha Liujunzi Tang?

post.zh: 陳皮半夏化痰濕，木香砂仁行氣醒脾。你沒碰丹參，今天這樣就對了。
post.en: Tangerine peel and pinellia resolve phlegm-damp; aucklandia and amomum move qi and wake the spleen. You left the danshen alone; that's the right instinct today.

lines.zh: 砂仁整顆煎，香氣出不來。用前打碎、標後下，煎到最後才放。
lines.en: Whole amomum won't give up its fragrance. Crush it just before use and label it add-late, in at the end of the cook.

post.zh: 打碎就好，不是磨成粉。粉會糊在藥渣裡。
post.en: Crushed, not powdered. Powder just sticks in the dregs.

note.zh: 兩條粉紅線，一支新螢光筆
note.en: Two pink lines, one new highlighter

guide.zh: 在白板前聽鄭老師收尾
guide.en: Teacher Cheng wraps up at the board

lines.zh: 今天兩個病人，兩條粉紅線。哪一條比較危險？
lines.en: Two patients, two pink lines today. Which was more dangerous?

lines.zh: 阿嬤那條。出血可以很快，而且藏在「撞到桌角」後面。
lines.en: Grandma's. Bleeding can move fast, and it hid behind “I bumped the table”.

lines.zh: 曾先生那條比較慢，但低血鉀也會讓心律亂掉。兩條都是藏在「這是食物」後面。
lines.en: Mr Tseng's was slower, but low potassium can upset the heart rhythm too. Both hid behind “it's only food”.

lines.zh: 中醫認為丹參活血、甘草調和，這些都沒錯。錯在沒有人把整袋東西攤開。
lines.en: TCM says danshen quickens blood and liquorice harmonises; none of that is wrong. What went wrong is that nobody had emptied the whole bag.

lines.zh: 粉紅色又用完了。這支新的給你，下次病人你來畫。
lines.en: The pink's run out again. This new one's yours; you do the drawing for the next patient.

lines.zh: 黃色西藥、綠色中藥、粉紅色兩個加起來會出事。
lines.en: Yellow for tablets, green for herbs, pink for “these two together mean trouble”.

lines.zh: 還有一個沒顏色的：病人說「沒有啦，就這些」。那一句要畫底線。
lines.en: And one with no colour: the patient saying “no, that's everything”. Underline that one.

note.zh: 照心臟科的話；紅旗就急診
note.en: Follow cardiology; red flags mean emergency

sub.zh: 牙齦沒流血了，藥都照林醫師說的
sub.en: Gums have stopped; everything as Dr Lin said

lines.zh: 牙齦沒再流血。華法林照林醫師說的今晚先停，明天去抽血。丹參粉她問可不可以送鄰居。
lines.en: No more gum bleeding. Warfarin held tonight as Dr Lin said; blood test tomorrow. She asks whether she can give the danshen powder to the neighbour.

lines.zh: 請不要送。也請鄰居帶藥袋來門診，我們一起看。
lines.en: Please don't give it away. And invite the neighbour to bring her own bag to clinic; we'll look together.

lines.zh: 我把中藥也加進手機的用藥備忘了。綠色的。
lines.en: I've added the herbs to my phone medicine list. In green.

sub.zh: 今晚華法林到底要不要吃
sub.en: Does she take warfarin tonight or not?

lines.zh: 早上好像聽到說華法林先停、又說減半，後來林醫師說今晚停一次。阿嬤搞糊塗了，到底怎麼吃？
lines.en: This morning I heard stop the warfarin, then halve it, then Dr Lin said hold tonight. Grandma's confused. What exactly does she take?

lines.zh: 只照林醫師的：今晚停一次，明天抽血後由他調。早上我講錯了，對不起。
lines.en: Only what Dr Lin said: hold tonight, and he adjusts after tomorrow's test. I got it wrong this morning, and I'm sorry.

lines.zh: 黑便、吐血、劇烈頭痛、一邊手腳無力，任何一樣就直接叫救護車。
lines.en: Black stools, vomiting blood, a severe headache, weakness down one side: any one of those, call an ambulance.

lines.zh: 好，我寫下來了。謝謝你直接講。
lines.en: OK, I've written it down. Thank you for being straight.

guide.en: Tidy the desk and go home

lines.zh: 診間的燈關了一半。脈枕旁的小卡被你換了一張新的：「先問藥袋，再摸脈，再問一次：還有嗎？」
lines.en: Half the clinic lights are off. You replace the card by the pulse pillow: “Ask for the bag, take the pulse, then ask once more: anything else?”

lines.zh: 白袍口袋裡，粉紅螢光筆還是新的。扣子縫好了，針腳細得像印的。
lines.en: In your coat pocket the pink highlighter is still new. The button is back on, the stitches as fine as print.

sub.zh: 兩條粉紅線、一帖沒開的方、一顆縫好的扣子
sub.en: Two pink lines, one formula not written, one button sewn back
